% tab_platforms, note. Generated by paper-v4/tools/make_tables.py; do not edit.
All runs use the baseline configuration (Section~\ref{sec:workload}). The CPU runtime had two logical CPUs of an Intel Xeon processor. Calls is the number of steady-state calls. With more than one call, the steady-state call is given as a mean $\pm$ sample standard deviation. Script gives the commit of the benchmark script. For the TPU, the Session column gives the time of the commit that holds the TPU result. For the T4 and for the CPU runtime, the Session column gives the start of the session, which is the first time stamp in the log output of the notebook. A dash marks the first calls of August 8, 2026, on the T4 and on the CPU runtime. These first calls ran with the profiler. The TPU has no run without the profiler, so the table shows its first call. \dag{} The first call on the TPU probably includes the profiler teardown (Section~\ref{sec:res-first}). Single times keep the decimals that the scripts round to, including trailing zeros.
